card.name: The 'uation' in discontinuation
card.fires_on: Mostly the ending 'uation' of 'discontinuation' after 'Consider discontin' in warnings. It also fires weakly on a few scattered words in label sentences, such as 'are', 'occur' or 'Although'.

modes.label: Discontinuation ending
modes.description: The final piece of 'discontinuation' after 'discontin' in a warning to consider stopping a drug.
modes.example: Consider discontin<<uation>> or dose-reduction of FIRDAP

modes.label: Scattered sentence words
modes.description: A verb or linking word in the middle of a label sentence, with no shared theme.
modes.example: This risk may<< occur>> early in treatment and may increase with duration
